requirements.quote:
All errors detected while processing the Message Header MUST be
   indicated by sending the NOTIFICATION message with the Error Code
   Message Header Error.  The Error Subcode elaborates on the specific
   nature of the error.
requirements.condition: An error is detected while processing the Message Header.
requirements.error_behavior: Send a NOTIFICATION message for the header error.
requirements.why_checkable: The error branch and emitted NOTIFICATION fields can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
The expected value of the Marker field of the message header is all
   ones.  If the Marker field of the message header is not as expected,
   then a synchronization error has occurred and the Error Subcode MUST
   be set to Connection Not Synchronized.
requirements.condition: A message header Marker field is encoded or validated.
requirements.required_behavior: The expected Marker field value is all ones.
requirements.why_checkable: The Marker bytes can be checked against the all-ones fixed value.

requirements.quote:
The expected value of the Marker field of the message header is all
   ones.  If the Marker field of the message header is not as expected,
   then a synchronization error has occurred and the Error Subcode MUST
   be set to Connection Not Synchronized.
requirements.condition: The message header Marker field is not all ones.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Connection Not Synchronized.
requirements.error_behavior: Report Connection Not Synchronized for the synchronization error.
requirements.why_checkable: The error branch and emitted NOTIFICATION fields can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
If at least one of the following is true:

      - if the Length field of the message header is less than 19 or
        greater than 4096, or

      - if the Length field of an OPEN message is less than the minimum
        length of the OPEN message, or

      - if the Length field of an UPDATE message is less than the
        minimum length of the UPDATE message, or

      - if the Length field of a KEEPALIVE message is not equal to 19,
        or

      - if the Length field of a NOTIFICATION message is less than the
        minimum length of the NOTIFICATION message,

   then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Bad Message Length.  The Data
   field MUST contain the erroneous Length field.
requirements.condition: The message header Length field is less than 19.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Error Subcode to Bad Message Length.
requirements.why_checkable: The error branch and emitted NOTIFICATION fields can be inspected and exercised.
